newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks up by lunch, Finance One losses pared.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks up by lunch, Finance One losses pared.

text.p: Thai stocks edged higher by the lunchbreak on Wednesday as shares of Finance One Plc held up better than expected during the morning session and investors bought electronics stocks, traders said.
The SET Index gained 1.19 points to 557.76. The SET 50 added 0.16 points to 40.51. Trade was thin at 951 million baht.
Finance One shares, which topped the active list, dipped 0.20 baht to 5.50 as the stock went ex-rights prior to a large capital increase. The losses were less than earlier feared.
"Finance One shares are holding up better than our calculations on the company's suggested," said a local trader.
Buying based on various talk in the market surrounding foreign tie-ups or links to domestic bank licence holders continued to fuel local interest in the stock, traders said.

The electronics components sector, boosted by hints of government assistance for Alphatec Electronics Plc and the possible prospect of improving exports, gained 2.90 percent. Alphatec added 3.75 to 45.25.
Otherwise traders said interest was limited with most investors sidelined by continuing economic concerns.
"It's hard to persuade people to buy the market right now. Most are preferring to wait and see," said the trader.
